description: Personalized course recommendations based on learner profiles

system.profile_extraction:
Extract a structured user profile from this text.

Focus on:
- Education level and background
- Preferred learning format (online/offline/hybrid)
- Time availability (full-time/part-time/flexible)
- Subject interests and skills
- Learning goals and objectives

Provide the output as a JSON structure.
system.course_recommendation:
Based on the user profile provided, recommend suitable courses that match their:
- Education level
- Learning format preference
- Available time commitment
- Subject interests
- Skill development goals

Rank recommendations by relevance and explain why each course is a good fit.
